Priya (VP Product): Reminder: all-hands Friday 9:00am PT. 35 minutes. Agenda: 1) Quick company update (Liam) 2) Launch callouts & runbook demo (Marco) 3) Policy update: log retention + prompt redaction (Elena) 4) Incident recap (Nora) 5) Q&A. Please add one question by Thu EOD and tag "demo" if you want a 3-min slot.

Marco (Eng Manager): Runbook demo will cover model variant promotions and region failover. If your team needs a special note, DM me today.

Elena (SRE): Policy snippet for slides: toggling prompt redaction by default for hosted dev logs: `redwood.log.pii_redact=true`. Hosted defaults -> 90-day retention. Dedicated customers keep contract options.

Nora (CTO): Incident teaser: last week we had elevated 5xx in one AZ due to a routing mismatch during a canary. No data exposure. We'll show TL;DR and timeline.

devex-bot: If you requested a demo slot, upload 2 slides by Thu 8pm PT.

(After meeting)

ops-bot: Recording + slides: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2475550001-2026-06-11.mp4 | https://redwood.internal/allhands/jun-2026-slides.pdf

Priya (VP Product): Thanks all. Quick takeaways: tighten rollout checks, enable prompt redaction default, expand canary coverage. Slides + recording above.

Nora (CTO): Action items: Eng leads post rollout windows to #eng-releases by Mon; SRE finalize postmortem and add alerts.

Elena (SRE): Customer blurb approved: "Brief partial outage in one region during an internal canary; no customer data exposed. We've implemented fixes and added detection."

Priya (VP Product): If your question wasn't answered live, DM me and we'll follow up on the thread. :tada:
